question_record.context: Suspicious activity has been detected involving a process trying to read sensitive credential data by accessing the memory of a crucial security system process. Such actions allow an attacker to extract authentication hashes or passwords, which might be written to the file system for exfiltration.
question_record.question: Which specific process was identified attempting to access and potentially extract sensitive information from the security system?
solution: A suspicious system hardware discovery was performed by an account with SID `S-1-5-21-561436748-3867387497-1732241745-3701`.

A process with Process ID `760` and Command Line `lsass.exe` created on `2024-07-02t07:28:35.8580921z` scanned or dumped memory from the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (lsass.exe), potentially extracting sensitive credentials.

0.name: Suspicious System Hardware Discovery
0.description: A known tool or technique was used to gather information on this device. Attackers might be trying to gather information about the target device or network for later attacks.

67.name: Sensitive credential memory read
67.description: A process scanned or dumped memory from the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (lsass.exe).  Accessing this process memory allows the attacker to extract secrets such as authentication hashes or passwords.  A copy of this memory may be written to the file system and exfiltrated to extract these credentials offline.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning
